Sample image from https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/human-pangenomics/index.html?prefix=submissions/76E3F239-A9A6-4B6B-840F-B49053807394--R3_verkko-v2.3.2_hybrid_assembly_qc/HG00146/quaak/
